The issuer generates solid revenue ($4.08B) and maintains healthy profitability with an operating margin of 13.5% (EBIT $552M) and net income of $384M. However, creditworthiness is constrained by high leverage (Total Liabilities/Total Assets of 82.3% and Liabilities-to-Equity of 4.67x) and weak short-term liquidity, as evidenced by a current ratio below 1.0 (Current Assets of $1.46B vs. Current Liabilities of $1.60B). Taking into account these moderate investment-grade operating metrics offset by elevated leverage, the financial profile is consistent with a lower investment-grade credit rating.

DECISION: BBB-
